shared_elements: stone relief carving (figures raised from a flat ground)
animals shown in profile, facing one direction
row of similar animals repeated in a line
horizontal band of repeated ornament dividing the surface
quadruped with head and legs rendered in side view
justification: Both surfaces organise carved animals in profile into horizontal rows and separate zones with a continuous band of repeated ornament, which is the most specific correspondence. But the manner is quite different: A is a smooth, deeply modelled, highly detailed relief with naturalistic fleece, drapery and rosettes on a dressed flat panel, while B is a shallow, schematic, angular carving on an irregular block, with no human figures and no comparable finish.
